response.sql: SELECT st.riskeval AS riskeval_status, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY st.riskeval;

assumptions.assumption: `chronotag` is compared as text by casting it to TEXT, as the request asks. The text form of a timestamp can differ from the literal bounds in precision or trailing zeros, so boundary-adjacent rows may be included or excluded differently than a true timestamp comparison would give.
The average is the mean of per-scan ratios (`gbsize / spanmin` computed for each scan, then averaged), not total GB divided by total minutes.
Scans with `spanmin` = 0 are treated as missing (NULLIF), so their ratio is NULL and AVG ignores it. Scans with NULL `gbsize` or `spanmin` are ignored the same way.
A NULL `sites.riskeval` is kept as its own group in the output, because the request does not say to drop it.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is a ratio of totals: total file size in GB divided by total scan minutes, over scans with both values present and a positive duration, per risk evaluation status.
alternatives.sql: SELECT st.riskeval AS riskeval_status, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY st.riskeval;
